description: Cheap live decision ($0.05): action (STRONG_BUY..STRONG_SELL), direction, conviction, a GO/WAIT answer for a side, the stance of each pillar and the measured hit rate. Same engine as get_decision ($1), without the trade plan, execution check, evidence and risks. Use as the default decision; get_decision ($1) adds full evidence and a trade plan, get_decision_sample is free but delayed.

side.description: Optional: answers GO / GO_SMALL / WAIT / NO_GO for this side

symbol.description: Crypto pair (ETHUSD), US ticker (NVDA) or ISIN

name: get_decision_lite
